behavioral.label: Focus composer
behavioral.evidence: onClick={onFocusComposer} — prop is passed through EmptyState's action={...} → actualPrimary → Button onClick. Handler is caller-supplied (not a Tauri command). Test at line 17-23 confirms the click fires the prop. Verdict works when prop is provided; button is hidden when prop is absent (guarded by ternary at line 25-27).

behavioral.label: recordGamifyGuiEvent('harness_redirect_viewed')
behavioral.evidence: useEffect fires on mount/gamifyEnabled change; calls gamifyGuiEvents.ts recordGamifyGuiEvent which delegates to voxTransport.recordGuiEvent. Short-circuits with Promise.resolve(null) when enabled===false. No user-visible interaction — purely a telemetry side-effect. Verdict works.

visual.issue: text-[10px] — bracket sizing for the footnote paragraph. Should use a design-token font size (e.g. text-[10px] is not in the standard Tailwind scale; prefer text-xs=12px or a custom ds-* token).

The

is placed AFTER the but is referenced by aria-labelledby="harness-redirect-title" on the

at line 19. In DOM order the labelling element appears after the labelled element, which is unconventional and may confuse some AT implementations that read the label before encountering the section.

<section aria-labelledby="harness-redirect-title"> — the label text ('Workspace → Quick Harness retained for deep links; execution surface is Loquela.') is a footnote, not a meaningful section heading. The actual heading ('Quick Harness lives in the composer') is inside EmptyState and not the aria-labelledby target, so the section's accessible name is the footnote string rather than the primary title.

DEFAULT_ICONS['no-connection'] uses text-amber-400. HarnessRedirect does not use the no-connection variant, so this does not fire here, but it is in the shared component used by this surface. Flagged for completeness.

Surface is registered as tier='live_backend' but the component renders purely as a redirect/empty-state with no live data. The surface is a tombstone pointing users elsewhere; tier should arguably be 'none' or 'generic_form' to accurately reflect that no live backend data is displayed.
